items.title: Bill Huntington and Charlie Suhor Interview, 1992-04-06
items.q: The famous Dick Martin show was on at that time. Well, he used to have a show right after that.

ctx.x: people wouldn't deliver. He'd talk about this over his radio. The famous Dick Martin show was on at that time. Well, he used to have a show right after that. Right after the Dick Martin show. And it was kind of a late hours jazz show and it was punctuated with his comments to his wife. she had some problems with narcotics and he'd be saying things like, Leah! Her name was Leah.
